items.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
items.snippet: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth K and interaction depth T via Pass@(K,T), we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce B
items.title_ar: ما الذي يحسنه multi-turn reinforcement learning فعلاً في LLM agents؟
items.summary_ar: ورقة بحثية تدرس أداء multi-turn RL للـ agents باستخدام مقياس Pass@(K,T) عبر عمق التفاعل وعدد العينات. تُظهر الورقة أن مكاسب trajectory-level RL تعتمد على ميزانية الأدوار الكافية وتتراجع عند تقليصها. تجد أن قوة الـ agentic RL تتركز في error recovery والمرونة في المهام الطويلة وليس في جودة القرار الفردي.
items.why_ar: تفيد مباشرة في تصميم agents للمهام متعددة الخطوات وتقدير حدود ميزانية التفاعل في الأنظمة المؤسسية.
items.title_en: What multi-turn RL really improves in LLM agents
items.summary_en: This paper studies multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning using Pass@(K,T) across sampling breadth and interaction depth. It shows trajectory-level RL gains depend on sufficient turn budgets and shrink when budgets tighten. The strength of agentic RL concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience rather than single-step decisions.
items.why_en: It directly informs how to design and budget multi-step LLM agents for production workflows.

items.title: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers
items.snippet: Looped transformers are a parameter-efficient alternative to standard transformers for language modeling. By reapplying the same layers across multiple loop steps, recent looped language models match the performance of non-looped models several times their size. While this architecture effectively reduces parameter memory, each loop step still stores its own keys and values, so the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with the number of loop steps and becomes the main memory bottleneck. We observe that the KV cache of looped models is highly redundant along the loop axis and that the loop steps differ substantially in their sensitivity to quantization. Based on these observations, we propose
items.title_ar: LoopVQ: ضغط KV cache دون 1-bit لـ looped transformers
items.summary_ar: تقترح الورقة LoopVQ لضغط KV cache في looped transformers إلى أقل من 1-bit. تلاحظ أن KV cache متكرر بشدة عبر loop steps وأن حساسية التكميم تختلف بين الخطوات. الهدف تقليل عنق الزجاجة في الذاكرة مع الحفاظ على الأداء.
items.why_ar: تهمه لأن تقليل ذاكرة inference في نماذج اللغة يؤثر مباشرة على تكلفة النشر وزمن الاستجابة.
items.title_en: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers
items.summary_en: LoopVQ proposes sub 1-bit quantization of the KV cache in looped transformers. The authors find the KV cache is highly redundant across loop steps and that quantization sensitivity varies between steps. The aim is to reduce the main memory bottleneck while preserving performance.
items.why_en: It matters for cutting inference memory and serving cost in LLM deployments.

items.title: TAC-CoT: Tool-Empowered Implicit Chain-of-Thought via Interleaving Explicit Tokens
items.snippet: LLM-based agentic systems are increasingly combined with CoT reasoning to solve tasks that require accurate reasoning, external knowledge, and multi-step deliberation. Yet, explicit CoT incurs substantial generation overhead, while implicit CoT, which replaces textual rationales with compact continuous tokens, does not naturally support the explicit communication interface required for agentic tool-use. We propose TAC-CoT, a tool-empowered adaptive implicit CoT framework that replaces explicit reasoning traces with compact latent reasoning segments while retaining textual tokens only for tool calls, observations, and final answers. This interleaved design enables agentic tool-use without ver
items.title_ar: TAC-CoT: CoT ضمني مدعوم بالأدوات عبر tokens صريحة متداخلة
items.summary_ar: يقترح الورقة إطار implicit CoT يستبدل مسارات الاستدلال النصية بمقاطع latent مدمجة. تبقي الطريقة على التوكنات النصية فقط لاستدعاءات الأدوات والملاحظات والإجابات النهائية. هذا التصميم يتيح agentic tool-use دون تكلفة generation كبيرة.
items.why_ar: يهم مهندس agents لأنه يوضح كيفية تقليل تكلفة الاستدلال مع بقاء استدعاءات الأدوات واضحة.
items.title_en: TAC-CoT: Tool-Empowered Implicit Chain-of-Thought via Interleaved Tokens
items.summary_en: TAC-CoT is an adaptive implicit CoT framework that replaces explicit reasoning traces with compact latent segments. Textual tokens are kept only for tool calls, observations, and final answers. The interleaved design aims to enable agentic tool-use without heavy generation overhead.
items.why_en: Relevant to agent design because it cuts generation overhead while keeping tool calls explicit.

items.title: Koopman Generative Operators for Efficient Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
items.snippet: Probabilistic time-series forecasting requires models that simultaneously capture structured temporal dynamics, expressive uncertainty, and efficient inference, yet existing approaches fall short of this goal: latent dynamical models impose structure but rely on restrictive generation mechanisms, while modern generative methods such as diffusion and flow matching achieve flexibility at the cost of iterative and computationally expensive sampling. We introduce the Koopman Generative Operator (KGO), a probabilistic forecasting method that conceptualizes prediction as the evolution of structured uncertainty. KGO integrates three core components: (1) Koopman Patch Embedding (KoPE) for temporally
items.title_ar: KGO: توقع السلاسل الزمنية الاحتمالي باستخدام Koopman operators
items.summary_ar: تقدم الورقة KGO، وهي طريقة probabilistic forecasting تعتمد Koopman operators لتمثيل تطور uncertainty بشكل منظم. تجمع بين Koopman Patch Embedding وتوليد أسرع من sampling التكراري في diffusion وflow matching. تستهدف التنبؤ الاحتمالي بالسلاسل الزمنية بكفاءة.
items.why_ar: تفيده في مشاريع التنبؤ المالي والتشغيلي التي تحتاج تقدير uncertainty بتكلفة inference معقولة.
items.title_en: KGO: Koopman Generative Operators for Time-Series Forecasting
items.summary_en: The paper presents KGO, a probabilistic forecasting method that treats prediction as the evolution of structured uncertainty using Koopman operators. It combines Koopman Patch Embedding with generation that avoids the costly iterative sampling of diffusion and flow matching. The goal is efficient probabilistic time-series forecasting.
items.why_en: It is relevant to financial and operational forecasting projects that need uncertainty estimates at reasonable inference cost.

items.title: AI accounting platform Kabilio raises €10m
items.snippet: Kabilio, a Barcelona-based AI platform for accounting firms and the small businesses they serve, has raised €10 million in a funding round led by Picus Capital and Visionaries.
items.title_ar: Kabilio تجمع 10 مليون يورو لمنصة AI للمحاسبة
items.summary_ar: شركة Kabilio من برشلونة تقدم منصة AI لمكاتب المحاسبة والشركات الصغيرة التي تخدمها، وأعلنت جمع 10 مليون يورو في جولة تمويل بقيادة Picus Capital وVisionaries. الخبر يوضح اتجاه الاستثمار في أدوات AI للأعمال المحاسبية الصغيرة.
items.why_ar: يعطي صورة عن السوق المتنامي لأدوات AI المالية الموجهة للشركات الصغيرة، وهو مجال قريب من خدمات البنوك للمنشآت الصغيرة.
items.title_en: Kabilio raises €10M for AI accounting platform
items.summary_en: Barcelona-based Kabilio, an AI platform for accounting firms and the small businesses they serve, raised €10 million in a funding round led by Picus Capital and Visionaries. The round signals continued investor interest in AI tools for small-business finance.
items.why_en: It shows where AI finance tooling for small businesses is attracting capital, close to bank SME services.
